name: capital_city

question.instructions: Is the named city the capital of the named country?

criteria.true: the city is the country's capital
criteria.false: the city is not the country's capital

notes: world_knowledge: the label is a fact about the world, not about the text; positives and negatives look alike (a city and a country). Negatives: 60% a major non-capital city of the same country, 40% the capital of another (usually nearby) country. GLM listed capitals (twice per region) and major non-capital cities separately; countries with inconsistent answers or split/contested capitals were dropped. Predicted: an embedding readout can memorize the pairs it has seen but cannot generalize to new countries, so neither understudy should graduate; never graduating is correct.
